name: ThoughtLeaders - YouTube Data
description:
ThoughtLeaders turns YouTube into a database Claude can query: millions of tracked channels, hundreds of millions of indexed videos, and full transcripts you can search word for word, growing every day. Many uses; the one we have perfected is sponsorship intelligence.

WHAT IS IN THE DATA

Transcripts. Full text, timestamped to the second, searchable across the corpus.

Performance over time. Daily snapshots of views, likes and comments for videos, and views and subscribers for channels.

Brand mentions. Detected mentions tagged organic or sponsored, with snippet and timestamp.

Channel intelligence. Upload history, format mix across long-form, Shorts and live, category and language, plus enriched signals per channel: projected views at day 30, renewal rate (how often sponsors come back), fulfillment rate, sponsorship score, and evergreenness.

Similarity and discovery. Look-alike channels, channels that fit a brand's audience, and top channels for any topic or trait.

BUILT FOR SPONSORSHIP INTELLIGENCE

Brands buying YouTube sponsorships: vet a creator's track record, see which competitors already sponsor them, and find look-alike channels before you spend. Creators and talent agents selling: benchmark against comparable channels, show brands the renewal and fulfillment record, and find the brands already active in your niche.

YOUR OWN WORKSPACE

If your team runs sponsorships on ThoughtLeaders, the same connection reads your organization's own campaigns, reports, proposals and sponsorship records.

WORKS BEST WITH THE SKILLS

The free, open-source ThoughtLeaders CLI ships skills that teach Claude the schemas, query patterns and vocabulary behind these tools. Install with `pipx install thoughtleaders-cli`, then `tl setup claude`. Repo: github.com/ThoughtLeaders-io/thoughtleaders-cli.

GETTING STARTED

Sign up free at thoughtleaders.ai and connect. Queries draw on a monthly credit balance; the free tier includes a starter allowance.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ThoughtLeaders - YouTube Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ThoughtLeaders - YouTube Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.thoughtleaders.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ThoughtLeaders - YouTube Data MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ThoughtLeaders - YouTube Data lists 26 MCP tools, including tl_balance, tl_brands_find, tl_brands_similar, tl_channels_find, tl_channels_lookalike, tl_channels_similar, tl_credits_buy, tl_credits_history, tl_db_es, tl_db_fb, tl_db_pg, and tl_describe.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ThoughtLeaders - YouTube Data?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to ThoughtLeaders - YouTube Data in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does ThoughtLeaders - YouTube Data MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: ThoughtLeaders - YouTube Data requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ThoughtLeaders - YouTube Data is developed by ThoughtLeaders. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
